attempts.sql: SELECT s.kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE f.is_test = FALSE AND (f.file_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo' OR f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%') AND f.file_id NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/tests/%' AND s.is_public = TRUE AND s.kind IN ('class','function','method') GROUP BY s.kind ORDER BY s.kind

request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
explanation: Joins symbols to files, restricts to non-test files under auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ excluding the tests folder, keeps public symbols of kind class, function or method, and counts them per kind.
sql: SELECT s.kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE f.is_test = FALSE AND (f.file_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo' OR f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%') AND f.file_id NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/tests/%' AND s.is_public = TRUE AND s.kind IN ('class','function','method') GROUP BY s.kind ORDER BY s.kind
